data.narrative:
MightyFly is a Series A drone and autonomous systems company founded by Manal Habib that has raised $10M to date. The Drones & Autonomous sector comprises eight private peers, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow category.

The valuation analysis applies a single triangulation method. Stage-Progression methodology, which is applicable, uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Series A to the subsequent funding stage, yielding an implied valuation of $20M. Peer-Median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set—only one adjacent-stage peer could be identified, falling short of the three-datapoint threshold needed for reliable median pricing. Relying on broader sector medians would risk material mispricings given heterogeneity in business models and technical approaches across autonomous systems.

The triangulated valuation range is $17M (low) to $23M (high), with a median of $20M. This range reflects a single-method analysis and should be interpreted with substantial uncertainty. Key risk factors include sparse peer data at this stage and valuation tier, and the early-stage nature of the company limiting financial visibility. Additional financial metrics, customer pipeline, or burn rate would strengthen conviction in this range.
